hotSeconds.label: Hot-layer acceleration window
hotSeconds.help: Raw frames from this recent span stay in memory first; the byte budget also caps actual retention. Persisted recordings remain available for cold reads.

videoSegmentSeconds.label: Video segment length
videoSegmentSeconds.help: Recording file granularity. Longer segments mean fewer files; persisted clips within a segment are readable while the newest clip waits for encoding.

videoIdleSeconds.label: Stop-sampling settle delay
videoIdleSeconds.help: How long after sampling stops before the current video segment is finalized. Faster finalization settles recent recordings sooner.
